entry.title: Petit Royales
entry.eyebrow: Compact, concentrated modern Romeo y Julieta
entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, floral sweetness, cocoa, mocha, nuts, fruit and pepper arrive with more concentration than the cigar’s short length suggests. The 47-ring format produces a dense, creamy smoke with medium strength, building from woody and floral notes into darker cocoa, coffee-like sweetness and a firmer spicy finish.
entry.noteHtml: A short, broad Romeo y Julieta that trades session length for flavour concentration and smoke volume. Review consensus is strongly positive on richness and progression for the format, while Cuban construction variability still leaves some risk of a firm draw or uneven burn.
